# Bundled fonts

Both fonts are licensed under the SIL Open Font License (OFL) 1.1, which permits redistribution.

| File | Family | Style | Weight |
|-|-|-|-|
| `eb-garamond-regular.ttf` | EB Garamond | normal | 400 |
| `eb-garamond-italic.ttf` | EB Garamond | italic | 400 |
| `eb-garamond-semibold.ttf` | EB Garamond | normal | 600 |
| `jetbrains-mono-regular.ttf` | JetBrains Mono | normal | 400 |
| `jetbrains-mono-medium.ttf` | JetBrains Mono | normal | 500 |

## Sources

- **EB Garamond** by Georg Duffner — https://github.com/georgd/EB-Garamond — OFL 1.1
- **JetBrains Mono** by JetBrains s.r.o. — https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono — OFL 1.1

## CSS @font-face declarations

Loaded by `dist/assets/styles.css` via `@font-face`. See `fonts.css` (loaded from `index.html`).
